restaurant_name: คลินิกทันตแพทย์ สุรันต์-ยงจิต 2 (Surun-Yongjit Dental Clinic 2)
text:
The second branch of local and family-owned dental clinic is conveniently located by Phetkasem Road.

Comparing to the first branch, this clinic is more modern and larger in space. There are many zones of waiting areas. I really love the waiting bar with a long table and high seats. You can bring your laptop and work here while waiting for a queue.

If you have Social Security, this clinic will automatically deduct your yearly dental budget from the system, no need for you to pay, if it is within the budget, indeed.

There are several dentist choices. Khun Dune, my dentist, is very renowned for his painless dentistry. Really recommend him if you are new here!

Transportation:
By car, go along Phetkasem Road and turn left at Soi 27/1. There, you will find parking lots which are private and reserved for clients. Alternatively, you can access here by BTS or MRT Bangwa, just a few minutes walk.

text:
Today I got my teeth cleaned 🦷 at Dr. Suran-Yongjit 2 Dental Clinic. Dr. Yongjit is very gentle; I didn't feel any pain or sensitivity at all. The doctor is kind, polite, and attentive throughout the procedure, constantly asking if I was in pain or if I was okay. For anyone near Phetkasem, Bang Khae, and wanting this kind of attentive treatment, book an appointment! The clinic is clean and beautiful, like being in a cafe. You'll feel safe and leave with beautiful teeth for sure! Bus driver confirms!!! 🥰❤️‍🔥🦷
❤️ Beautiful face, beautiful hair, beautiful figure – don't forget to take care of your dental health too, so you can have a beautiful and charming smile! 🦷🥰
